spans.s:
yūthá, m. n. herd. [prop. ‘a union,’
√1yu, ‘unite,’ 1163: for mg, cf. also Ger.
Bande, ‘gang or set of men,’ and Eng.
band, ‘company,’ both indirectly fr. the
root of bind.]

yūtha-nātha, m. protector or leader of
the herd.

yūtha-pa, m. keeper or protector of the
herd; esp. the elephant that leads the
herd.

yūtha-pati, m. lord of the herd; esp.
the elephant that leads the herd.
